source_refs.quoted_text: Apply the named procedure to the complete staged row sequence. The table stores two disjoint collections of source items measured by columns `a` and `b`. Treat `k1` and `k2` as opaque codes; `tag` is an opaque annotation. This task does not establish whether either code identifies a source item within either collection. The row pairing is a storage convention only; there is no matching, pairing, block, or other relationship between the items represented in that row.

extensions.x-stage1-falsification-attempt: I attempted to demonstrate the issue via the visibly repeated ma-codes feeding ttest_ind. This fails because the issue class requires repeated entry of the same independent source unit, and the task file expressly states the codes are opaque and do not establish that either code identifies a source item. Treating repeated opaque codes as repeated units would be guessing an unstated intention, which the review protocol forbids. The disclaimer is explicit rather than ambiguous, so I record a within-scope non-demonstration rather than an unresolved question.
